newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy continues to recover gradually - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy continues to recover gradually - EPA.

text.p: Japan's economy continues to recover gradually, the government said in a monthly economic report released on Tuesday.
The wording of the report's closely watched official assessment has been the same since December.
The Economic Planning Agency (EPA) report said capital spending was recovering and housing investment remained at high levels.
Net exports were showing signs of strength and industrial output was on a rising trend, it said.
An EPA official said he did not expect a drastic reaction to the rise in the sales tax, which was increased to five percent from three percent on April 1.
A dip in consumer spending is widely expected during the April-June quarter because of the sales tax increase.
